name: tool-dev-my-first-anna-app
description: Cooking assistant brain for the Smart Kitchen Assistant app: suggests recipes from available ingredients, teaches how to cook a pictured dish, and summarizes conversations. Uses host sampling (no API key).
author: Smart Kitchen Assistant

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Produce the kitchen assistant's next reply for a conversation. Optionally include a text description of photos/video frames (ingredients or a finished dish) produced by a vision model.

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: Conversation so far: [{role:'user'|'assistant', content:string}]. Last item is the new user turn.

parameters.name: vision_context
parameters.description: Optional analysis of the images attached to the latest user turn.

tools.name: summarize_conversation
tools.description: Return a short title and one-paragraph summary for a conversation.
